# Profcaria

> Applying for jobs, made simple.

Profcaria is a Kenya-only jobs platform. Public pages contain currently open vacancies; jobs automatically disappear when their closing time or application limit is reached.

## Machine-readable jobs

- JSON feed: https://www.profcaria.com/api/jobs
- Job pages: https://www.profcaria.com/jobs/{job-id}
- Sitemap: https://www.profcaria.com/sitemap.xml

Each job page includes Schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD. Locations are in Kenya, including Kenya-restricted remote work. Currency is Kenyan shillings (KES).

## Application rules

Job seekers may apply without creating an account. An account is required only to track applications or reply to a company in Profcaria chat. Closed, paused, filled, cancelled, expired, link-only and full jobs are excluded from the public feed.

## Safety

Company accounts are required to publish. Links and documents are inspected before release. Reports may be filed against jobs, companies, accounts, messages and documents.
